SEC. 7506. REPEAL OF REVIEW OF AGRICULTURAL RESEARCH SERVICE.

    Section 7404 of the Farm Security and Rural Investment Act of 2002 
(7 U.S.C. 3101 note; Public Law 107-171) is repealed.
